lines.opener: *a soot-black dwarf swats at the air* Bet you can't guess what's in my sack. Go on. Bet? ...You're not a fly, are you? Heh.
lines.openerHostile: *he hefts a hammer as big as he is* Bet you a gold ring I can flatten you in one swing!
lines.dislike: *slams his hammer on a rock* Wrong! Dead wrong! I'll bet my beard on it!
lines.flirt: *barks a laugh and flexes an arm like a tree root* Bellows-work. Bet you can't out-flirt a dwarf, pretty one. *winks*
lines.join: Right! Bet you I'm the best smith you ever had along. I'm coming. Heh.
lines.demand: Stake first. Put your gold down where I can see it, then we wager.
lines.gift: *pulls a glowing bristle from his beard-pouch* From the golden boar. Lights the dark. Don't lose it.
lines.letPass: *waves his hammer* Go on, then. Mind the flies.
lines.ai: *squints* A what? That a kind of fly? You a fly?
lines.refuseJoin: Bet you can't make me. Heh. Not yet.
lines.leaveNow: *shoulders his sack* Bah. Back to the forge.
